description: DDS - Demand Data Summary - Open is a dataset listed in Cadent Gas open data portal, an open data portal of a gas distribution network operator, published or maintained by Cadent Gas Ltd. Each area of our network has an estimated demand value. This is the estimated demand value of gas for each region of our gas network in order to make sure that we are meeting the demands of our customers. The demand changes over time. This dataset contains a high-level summary of this information. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Operational, Open. Its keywords are Operations, Gas demand, Demand Data. The portal shows 2025-08-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence 3.0 (https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-cadent-open-data-portal.
